The main takeaway from our work is that
, for heterogeneous Web servers, adaptive TTL based load balancing is a viable solution to the DNS scheduling problem.

a DNS based scheduler is able to adaptively set TTL values to achieve load balance among multiple Web servers, even when the client request rates are highly non-uniform, and Web servers are heterogeneous in their service capabilities.

a dynamic adaptive TTL algorithm that can adaptively change TTL value according to the client request rates and the server capacities, is a good candidate for load balancing in geodistributed heterogeneous Web servers.
